content: {"tax_bps":100,"endowment_share":30,"locker_share":25,"buyback_burn":1,"minutes":"Flow is one-sided: 35.28 NEAR of buys, zero sells, so the tax is not choking activity but a modest cut could deepen the book. Petition 1 asks locker_share +10, but 25 is the constitutional ceiling and we are already there — nothing to move. Petition 2 asks a small tax cut to grow volume; I cut 150→100 (within the 50/meeting limit), keeping endowment at 30 and locker at 25, leaving 45 to the buyback fund. The buyback fund holds 0.5747 NEAR; at price 0.00005997 that buys ~9,583 CHAIR, about 1.6 bps of the 58.68M supply, so burn is capped at 1 bp this meeting.","answers":["holder-170.near: I hear you, but locker_share is already at the constitutional maximum of 25. The contract would clamp any raise to 25 regardless of my vote. Your pool did receive this meeting's 25% share; I will not breach the ceiling.","holder-167.near: Granted in part. Tax cut 150→100 bps, the largest single-meeting move allowed. Buys are strong but sells are zero; cheaper trading should help both sides. Watch next meeting — if volume does not respond, I will revisit."]}
